arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Lechner argued the lower decision would upset property law.
He claimed the government recently created an implied reversionary interest.
Justice Scalia questioned the government's stance in the Great Northern case.
Justice Alito asked about the government's reserved interest under Section 1912.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Brandt Trust seeks full fee simple ownership of the land. The United States seeks to retain a reversionary interest in the property.

The United States wants to keep a reversionary interest.
